user.title: Safety Inputs
user.description:
Select the load and safety inputs for bounded load shedding:
{summary}

data_description.grid_power: Optional grid/import power sensor used only as a safety and diagnostic input. The load sensor below is authoritative for shedding decisions.
data_description.battery_soc: Battery state-of-charge sensor used by threshold safety mode and availability checks. An unavailable, unknown, or wrong-unit value blocks planner actions and can trigger the safety stop.

load_monitoring.title: Load Monitoring
load_monitoring.description: Monitor total load using {sensor_name}. If the average load exceeds the limit, optional devices will be turned off.

data_description.load_sensor: Authoritative whole-house power sensor. Available, non-negative readings in watts drive shedding decisions; unavailable, unknown, or unsupported-unit readings block planner actions.
data_description.max_load: Hard average-load ceiling in watts. If the average exceeds it, the coordinator sheds one lowest-priority active device per evaluation cycle.
data_description.averaging_period: Time window used to calculate average load. A longer window smooths short spikes, but it never extends the separate safety-input availability limit.
data_description.safety_reserve: Watts kept unused below the maximum load to protect headroom for unexpected demand.
data_description.hysteresis: Additional watt margin kept after a shedding decision to reduce on/off cycling; it never enables a device.
data_description.threshold_count: How many custom power-limit and time pairs to use. Maximum 10; power limits must be strictly increasing.
data_description.threshold_1_power: Power limit 1 that begins this tier's dwell timer. When available aggregate load remains above the limit, the coordinator sheds one logical device after the configured dwell time.
data_description.threshold_1_time: How many seconds available aggregate load must remain continuously above threshold 1. A short spike, unavailable input, or invalid telemetry never confirms shedding.
data_description.threshold_2_power: Power limit 2 that begins this tier's dwell timer. When available aggregate load remains above the limit, the coordinator sheds one logical device after the configured dwell time.

devices.title: Optional Devices
devices.description:
Select the logical loads to manage, remove any you do not want to shed, and optionally add a custom load. For each selected load, choose the on/off entity. Configured: {count}

Available: {discovered}

data.name: Friendly name (leave empty to keep the discovered name)
data.power_sensor: Power sensor (auto-discovered when available; choose another to override)
data.add_another: Add another custom device after this one

data_description.discovered_devices: Candidate logical loads only. Select candidates that map to real controllable entities; unselected candidates are ignored, and a measurement sensor is never toggled directly.
data_description.add_custom_device: If enabled, opens a control-mapping form after discovery so you can add a switch, light, or input_boolean manually.
data_description.entity: The actual on/off control entity that the integration may command. This is the physical service target and must be a switch, light, or input_boolean.
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in entities, priorities, notifications, and logs. Leave it empty to keep the discovered or Home Assistant name.
data_description.expected_power: Expected load in watts used to estimate the effect of shedding. It is planning telemetry only and never authorizes an activation.
data_description.power_sensor: Measured device-power sensor used for telemetry and readback. Available non-negative readings are never used to authorize an activation.
data_description.actuators: Optional additional entities in the same logical load group, such as a climate entity paired with a switch. Every actuator must provide causal readback; partial, unknown, or unavailable group state is fail-closed and cannot confirm ON or OFF.
data_description.add_another: Controls only the custom-device form loop. It has no runtime effect; enable it to configure another custom device before assigning priorities.

priority.title: Priority & Pause

data_description.priority_1: Choose the device for this position. Position 1 is protected longest; later positions are shed first when load is too high.
data_description.priority_2: Choose the device for this position. Later positions are shed first when load is too high.

data_description.pause_period: Seconds a device remains paused after the coordinator turns it off, reducing rapid cycling before it becomes eligible again. Emergency safety stops still apply.

grid_loss.title: Grid Loss Behavior
grid_loss.description:
Choose how to detect grid loss. When grid is lost, all optional devices are turned off immediately.

{battery_info}

data.grid_loss_sensor: Binary sensor: ON = grid available, OFF = grid lost

data_description.grid_loss_mode: Select the safety source. A valid, available source is required for ordinary shedding decisions.
data_description.grid_loss_sensor: Used only in binary-sensor mode. It must be available and report ON for normal operation; OFF, unknown, unavailable, or missing input triggers an emergency stop of optional devices.
data_description.battery_soc: Used in battery-threshold mode. It must be an available sensor with a percent unit; SoC at or below the threshold, unknown, unavailable, or invalid input triggers the safety stop.
data_description.battery_threshold: Battery SoC percentage at or below which the system treats the safety source as lost. A higher value protects the battery more and sheds optional loads sooner.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Power Orchestrator
reconfigure.description: Update safety sources, thresholds, managed devices, and runtime limits without removing the integration.

data_description.load_sensor: Authoritative whole-house power sensor. Invalid, unavailable, unknown, or wrong-unit values block planner actions.
data_description.max_load: Hard total-load ceiling in watts used for bounded shedding decisions.
data_description.averaging_period: Average-load window; it never extends independent safety availability limits.
data_description.safety_reserve: Watts held back below the maximum to protect headroom during shedding.
data_description.hysteresis: Additional margin kept after a shedding decision; it never enables a device.
data_description.pause_period: Seconds a shed device remains paused to prevent rapid repeated shedding.
data_description.grid_loss_mode: Select the authoritative grid-loss safety source.
data_description.grid_loss_sensor: Required in sensor mode; it must be available and ON for normal operation.
data_description.battery_soc: Required in battery-threshold mode; it must be available, valid, and above the threshold.
data_description.battery_threshold: SoC at or below which the safety source is considered lost and optional loads are shed.
data_description.devices: Complete logical-device mappings, including control entities, expected watts, actuator groups, and shedding priorities.
data_description.threshold_count: Number of finite, strictly increasing power/time threshold pairs.
